coverage: Selected inventory records outside forests in central Geneva. Historical positioning may be inaccurate by about 25 m; recent surveys about 1 m.
title: SITG — Inventaire cantonal des arbres isolés
identity: ID_ARBRE is documented stable but observed duplicate IDs must be explicitly resolved or quarantined during normalization. OBJECTID is not permanent.
completeness: All object IDs in the declared window fetched in validated batches; membership rechecked after download. Not a transactionally consistent upstream snapshot.
processing: Geographic subset; source properties retained except Geneva observer identities omitted. No inferred biological trees or deduplication.
